findings.claim: Dropping diagnostics for members declared only in referenced assemblies, and documenting that their defining projects report those problems, matches the recorded product behavior; the absence of MsgPack004 or a formatter in the consuming project is not a defect.

receipt_plan.detail: [L8] Types from referenced assemblies are deliberately not analysed and receive no formatter from the compiling assembly; the defining assembly owns validation and formatting.
